maddeler.e:
انسلبت (form VII)
# اِنْسَلَبْتُ (insalabtu) /in.sa.lab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
# اِنْسَلَبْتَ (insalabta) /in.sa.lab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
# اِنْسَلَبْتِ (insalabti) /in.sa.lab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
# اِنْسَلَبَتْ (insalabat) /in.sa.la.bat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
